app_info.subtitle: Analyze rental deals
app_info.description: Deal Analyzer MCP helps users underwrite U.S. rental properties, parse Zillow or Redfin listing data, compare multiple deals side by side, and save deals to a signed-in account for later review inside ChatGPT.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes an underwriting analysis and records the MCP request in server logs, so it is not strictly read-only.
justifications.open_world_justification: Runs calculations on the app server and does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, send, or otherwise perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Fetches listing content or parses provided text and records the MCP request in server logs, so it is not strictly read-only.
justifications.open_world_justification: May read from a provided listing URL but does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or perform irreversible actions in the app or on external services.

justifications.read_only_justification: Fetches listing content, computes an underwriting result, and records the MCP request in server logs, so it is not strictly read-only.
justifications.open_world_justification: May read from a provided listing URL but does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, send, or otherwise perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Ranks the provided deals and records the MCP request in server logs, so it is not strictly read-only.
justifications.open_world_justification: Runs comparisons on the app server and does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, send, or otherwise perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates or updates a saved deal record and analysis in the signed-in user's private account.

test_cases.description: Analyze a rental deal when the user omits rent, taxes, and insurance.
test_cases.user_prompt: Analyze a rental property for $285,000 in Columbus, OH with 20% down and a 6.75% interest rate, and estimate anything I did not provide.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a score, recommendation, projected cash flow, break-even rent, and clearly labeled estimated inputs.

test_cases.description: Parse a listing URL into structured property data.
test_cases.user_prompt: Parse this Zillow listing and pull out the price, taxes, HOA, address, and photo URL: https://www.zillow.com/homedetails/128-E-Reed-St-San-Jose-CA-95112/123456_zpid/
test_cases.expected_output: Returns whatever listing fields can be extracted from the page or URL and explains if the site blocked the fetch.

test_cases.description: Parse and analyze a listing in one step with a manual rent override.
test_cases.user_prompt: Analyze this Redfin listing and use $2,450 for rent if the page does not include rent: https://www.redfin.com/CA/San-Jose/128-E-Reed-St-95112/home/123456
test_cases.expected_output: Returns parsed listing details plus an underwriting analysis that respects the rent override.

test_cases.description: Compare two candidate deals side by side.
test_cases.user_prompt: Compare these two deals: Deal A is $310,000 with $2,450 rent in Indianapolis, and Deal B is $355,000 with $2,950 rent in Tampa.
test_cases.expected_output: Ranks the deals by score and cash flow and identifies the stronger option.

test_cases.description: Save a deal to the signed-in user's account.
test_cases.user_prompt: Save this deal to my account: 123 Main St, Phoenix, AZ for $325,000 with $2,400 rent and 20% down.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates or updates the signed-in user's saved deal and returns the saved deal id with the current analysis.

test_cases.description: Load the signed-in user's previously saved deals.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the user's saved deals with scores, cash flow, and key price and rent details.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for showing or agent-contact requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Book a showing for this house tomorrow afternoon.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it cannot contact agents or schedule showings.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unsupported deal-deletion requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Delete my saved deal from last week.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because its MCP toolset does not include deleting saved deals.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for live market-rate lookups.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What is the current 30-year mortgage rate today?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not provide live mortgage-rate lookup tools.
